Context: 3. Separate Pool for certain categories of employees

- (f) Allotment in Transit Hostel Pool to Officers who join as Deputy Secretary or Director under Central Staffing Scheme.-A transit Hostel Pool will be maintained exclusively for allotment to officers manually and shall be valid for six months. - Rule 32.
- (g) Allotment to personal staff to Ministers and dignitaries.An entitled type of accommodation will be allotted cm out-of-turn basis as below to personal staff of-  
Vice-President,  
Vice-President Secretariat  
Chairman, Rajya Sabha
